articles.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
articles.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

articles.title: France holds new strikes and protests as unions demand immediate answers
articles.description: Five of France's unions join a wave of strikes and protests in a national day of action.

articles.title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
articles.description: Authorities in British Columbia say evidence suggests an animal may have been involved in the women's deaths.

articles.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

articles.title: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections
articles.description: Democrats secured some big wins - and a few historic firsts - earning congratulations from President Trump.

articles.title: Russia attacks Ukrainian aid hub in one of the deadliest strikes since war began
articles.description: Russian strikes on an aid hub killed at least 40 people - making it one of Russia's deadliest attacks on Ukrainian civilians since the full-scale invasion began, officials said.

articles.title: Cyber attack threatens French blood banks
articles.description: Blood bank sites in France are the latest to be hit by cyber attackers.

articles.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
articles.description: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.
